notes: Ohio State vs Indiana, 1933-34 season, at the Coliseum (Columbus), coach H.G. Olsen; captain Conrad; referee 'Frank Lane-Cincinnati'; halftime score Ohio 15, Indiana 15. Left margin of the scoresheet is cropped/cut off on the scan, truncating the first 1-2 letters of every player surname on the page (e.g. header 'chio State' for 'Ohio State', 'olburn' for what is confidently 'Colburn'). High-confidence reconstructions used for 'Colburn', 'Olson' (common surnames) and 'Conrad' (cross-verified against the printed Captain field). All other player names (OSU: Low/Itlinger/Sequist/Itner; Indiana: all seven) are transcribed as the literal visible fragment only -- the true full surnames could not be confidently reconstructed and should be treated as incomplete/uncertain, not invented. The sheet's columns are G. (field goals made), F. (ambiguous - times fouled/free-throw opportunities, could not be reliably mapped to a standard stat and was omitted), M.F. (free throws made), P. (personal fouls), PTS. (points, printed directly). No attempts (FGA/FTA), minutes, rebounds, assists, turnovers, steals, or blocks are on this sheet, so fg/ft values given are MAKES ONLY (not 'made-attempted' format) and reb/ast/to/stl/blk/min keys are omitted entirely. Exact game date is illegible handwritten cursive at the bottom of the page (only 'YEAR 1934' is clearly legible); left as null rather than guessed. Checksum passes for both teams: OSU player pts sum to 27 (matches team score and printed TOTALS), Indiana player pts sum to 23 (matches team score and printed TOTALS); the G/F/M.F./P. column sums also independently match the printed TOTALS row for both teams, confirming the numeric transcription is accurate even though the PTS column does not equal a simple 2*FG+FTmade formula for individual rows (an idiosyncrasy of this era's scoresheet, not a transcription error).
